en: Dependent on a state that is not a root and has a root to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is not a root and has a root to be abandoned by vision, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not a root and has a root not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is not a root and has a root to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, there arises a non-root phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a non-root phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, [there arises] a non-root phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation... by way of the root condition.
A state arises by way of root condition. (The single root-duad is abbreviated.
Under root there are three; under predominance there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are three.
